conditions.document-part-missing: A document-part owner whose document exists but whose part does not: DokumentCast.objects.get raises an uncaught DoesNotExist in the same method.
conditions.no-identifier-pattern: get_record_from_ident has no pattern for the value (cooperation and file owners referenced by numeric ID, or a nonexistent reference); the intended ImportDataMissingReferencedValueError is never raised.
conditions.owner-lacks-read-attribute: The resolved owner model has no attribute named read_field_name (User exposes history_vazba, not historie).
conditions.owner-not-persisted: The owner is created in the same import or by a batch that is not guaranteed to run earlier.

defects: The fallback for an owner not returned by get_record_from_ident iterates self.records; the field exposes only the class method get_records(), so AttributeError is raised (line 1417).

Even after that is corrected, the fallback assigns filtered_records[0].historie regardless of read_field_name, so component (komponenty) and file (soubory) owners would receive the wrong object (line 1421).
defects.effect: run_data_import catches only ImportData* errors per row (webclient/cron/tasks.py:1470); the exception reaches the outer except Exception (webclient/cron/tasks.py:1519) and the whole validation job fails with core.admin.import_data.error.unexpected_error, concealing every other check in the ZIP.
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of VazbaLookupImportField._process_value deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: VazbaLookupImportField fallback raises AttributeError and ignores read_field_name

conditions.prefixed-key-update-delete: An UPDATE or DELETE row of a class whose id column maps to IntegerImportField and carries a primary_key_prefix.

defects: Validation resolves the key with _parse_primary_key (prefix-(.*) -> 769), but the row stored for the data phase is serialized through IntegerImportField, whose pattern -?\d+ captures the prefix dash (hdtm-769 -> -769).
create_records then calls model.objects.get(id=-769); DoesNotExist propagates and the whole import is revoked.
defects.effect: Validation passes, the data phase fails and the whole import is revoked (rollback complete in B06); the report shows a raw traceback.
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of the prefixed key serialization deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: UPDATE/DELETE of a prefixed numeric key is serialized as a negative ID and fails after validation

conditions.lookup-format: A non-empty RuianLookupImportField value that does not start with ruian-<digits>.

defects: The setter calls re.match(r'ruian-(\d+)', value).group(1) without checking the match; any other text raises AttributeError.
defects.effect: AttributeError is not an ImportData* error; validation ends with 'Neočekávaná výjimka.' and conceals every later row (N07: after 79 of 364 rows).
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of RuianLookupImportField deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: A RUIAN reference not shaped like ruian-<digits> aborts the whole validation job

conditions.lookup-format: A non-empty GenericForeignKeyImportField value that does not match (?:\w+-)?(\d+).

defects: A value not matching (?:\w+-)?(\d+) is passed unconverted to objects.get(kod=value); Django raises ValueError ("Field 'kod' expected a number"), which is neither DoesNotExist nor an ImportData* error.
defects.effect: Validation ends with the raw Django message and conceals every later row (N07 second upload: at 57%).
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of GenericForeignKeyImportField deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: A non-numeric RUIAN notification value aborts the whole validation job

conditions.lookup-format: A non-empty geometry value (model Point/GeometryField) that is not WKT/EWKT text.

defects: GeomImportField._process_value calls GEOSGeometry(value, srid=...) without catching its ValueError; the docstring promises ImportDataError.
defects.effect: ValueError 'String input unrecognized as WKT EWKT, and HEXEWKB.' is not an ImportData* error; validation stops and shows the raw GEOS message, concealing every later row (V04: after 9 of 30 rows).
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of GeomImportField deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: A geometry value that is not WKT aborts the whole validation job

defects.title: An empty distribution name aborts the whole validation job

conditions.empty-cell: An empty distribution cell (read by pandas as NaN).

defects: pd.read_csv(dtype=str) turns an empty cell into NaN (cron/tasks.py:1401); (name or '').strip() keeps the truthy NaN and calls .strip() on a float.
defects.effect: AttributeError is not an ImportData* error; validation ends with 'Neočekávaná výjimka.' at 17% and conceals every later row (V04: after 21 of 28 rows).

defects.prerequisite: Developer fix (empty CSV cells read as NaN must not reach str methods) deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
defects.title: An empty paradata path aborts the whole validation job

conditions.empty-cell: An empty paradata path cell (read by pandas as NaN).

defects: (self.value_dict.get('path') or '').strip() calls .strip() on the NaN of an empty cell.
defects.effect: AttributeError instead of 'Chybí povinné pole: path'; aborts validation like F27 (source-confirmed, not yet reached live).

defects.title: A spatial unit with only one coordinate system is rejected although the other is derived

conditions.single-system-geometry: An az_pian row with exactly one of geom/geom_sjtsk filled (geom_system names the filled one).

defects: check_required_fields requires the non-nullable Pian.geom and Pian.geom_sjtsk on the raw row before transform_geometries derives the missing one, so the derivation is unreachable.
defects.effect: The row is rejected ('Chybí povinné pole: geom_sjtsk' / 'geom'); in an apply batch this blocks the whole import (B02 insert, V05 update).
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix of the required-field check (derive before checking) deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.

defects.title: Moving an ADB to another documentation unit fails in the data phase

conditions.case: An az_adb UPDATE that changes dokumentacni_jednotka (the primary key).

defects: Adb's primary key is its documentation unit; changing it makes save() INSERT a second row with the same ident_cely instead of moving the record.
defects.effect: psycopg2 UniqueViolation adb_ident_cely_key in the data phase; the whole import is revoked (V05r-retry row 25). Validation accepts the row.
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix (move the ADB or reject the change at validation) deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.

defects.title: Deleting a document whose part is linked to an archaeological record fails in the data phase

conditions.case: A dokumenty DELETE of a document with a document part linked to an archaeological record.

defects: The cascade-deleted DokumentCast has no active_transaction; its post_delete signal (dokument/signals.py:280) calls initial_archeologicky_zaznam.save_metadata(None), which raises 'No Fedora transaction'.
defects.effect: ValueError in the data phase; the whole import is revoked (V12 row 4).
defects.prerequisite: Developer fix (pass the import transaction to cascaded children or delete parts explicitly) deployed to the test instance; record resolved_in here and rebuild the pack.
